goal: Explain how to study to a new teacher, from memory

ideas.source: The Testing Effect: Why Retrieval Beats Rereading
ideas.text: Effortful retrieval, the kind that feels a little hard, produces larger gains than easy retrieval.

ideas.source: The Testing Effect: Why Retrieval Beats Rereading
ideas.text: The advantage only appears after a delay

asks.q: You quiz yourself. Which quiz does more for you, the easy one or the one that makes you sweat, and why?
asks.answer: The hard one, the effort is what builds it.

asks.q: What if you did all your quizzing in one evening?
